headline: Brazil's Ibovespa Suffers Steep Weekly Decline Amid Fiscal Uncertainty
summary: Brazil's Ibovespa index experienced trading halts following a weekly drop reaching 17%, driven by shifting election expectations and fiscal concerns.
why: The Ibovespa is Latin America's primary equity benchmark, highly sensitive to Brazilian sovereign fiscal stability and domestic political trends.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Fiscal uncertainty and political expectations caused a 17% drop in the benchmark index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The index fell as market participants reacted to domestic political developments and fiscal policy concerns in Brazil.
